title: TruthWeaver decision record
description: A Decision stored as JSON by DecisionRecord.PrintJson and read back by DecisionRecord.TryParseJson: the result, the faults, the trace and the trace tree, with the identity of the rule and the evaluation options. The reader rejects a member that this schema does not name.

formatVersion.description: The version of this format. The reader accepts only 1.

argumentValues.description: Whether the literal argument values of faulting terms are in the record. 'omitted' (the default) writes each argument's name and kind without its value.

faults.description: Every fault the evaluation absorbed, in the order they occurred.

trace.description: The flat trace: every node visited or skipped, in evaluation order. Absent when the decision has no trace.

traceTree.description: The trace tree: the rule's tree with the outcome of each node. Absent when the decision has no trace tree.

rule.description: The rule that made the decision.

canonicalTextSha256.description: The SHA-256 hash of the UTF-8 bytes of the canonical rule text, as 64 lower-case hexadecimal digits.

name.description: A name for the rule, chosen by the caller.

version.description: A version string for the rule, chosen by the caller.

options.description: The evaluation options the decision was made with.

faultBudget.description: The fault count at which the evaluation stops, or null for no limit.

timeout.description: The time limit in the .NET constant TimeSpan format ([-][d.]hh:mm:ss[.fffffff]), or null for none.

includeResolvedValues.description: Whether the trace shows the values that data sources resolved.

fault.description: One fault: the term that failed and its exception.

term.description: The identity of a term: the predicate name, the literal arguments and the variable arguments, each sorted by name.

argument.description: A literal argument. 'value' is present only when argumentValues is 'included'. Strings, GUIDs (format D) and instants (round-trip format O) are JSON strings, Int64 and Decimal values are JSON numbers, Boolean values are JSON booleans and an array kind is a JSON array of its element kind.

variable.description: A variable argument: the data source and the query, written as from("source", "query") in rule text.

exception.description: The exception of a fault: its full type name and message. 'variable' is present exactly when the type is TruthWeaver.Abstractions.VariableResolutionException.

traceEntry.description: One trace entry. 'result' is null exactly when 'notEvaluated' is true.

traceNode.description: One trace tree node with its operands. A node that was not evaluated has a null result and no children.
